### 🟡 Changes recommended The updated workflow contains confirmed logic issues around re-request retry behavior and stderr capture that can cause avoidable timeouts and missing diagnostics. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview Syncs the repository’s required “Copilot review gate” workflow with the upstream canonical gist, ensuring the gate only passes on a substantive Copilot review (not an error “COMMENTED” review) and can re-request review when Copilot fails to produce one. **Changes:** - Tightens review detection by requiring a specific review-body marker and a bot-login allowlist. - Adds bounded re-request logic (`MAX_REREQUESTS`) and updates polling behavior (do-while; green exit if PR closes mid-wait). - Expands workflow permissions to `pull-requests: write` to support re-requesting a Copilot review.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | .github/workflows/copilot-review-gate.yml | Re-vendors the Copilot review gate workflow from the canonical gist, updating detection/retry logic and required permissions. |
Review details - **Files reviewed:** 1/1 changed files - **Comments generated:** 3 - **Review effort level:** Lite
